verification_notes.note: Corrected H1 2026 net income YoY comparison: source data shows net income of EUR 152.7 million was approximately flat YoY (vs EUR 153.3 million in H1 2025), not +2%. Updated to reflect accurate YoY change.

Removed unsupported EUR 269 million deposit plan lag figure (source only states deposits were below plan without quantify). Corrected loan growth claim: source states business volumes tracked to plan, not above plan.

redundancy_check.note: All final units were cross-checked for duplicate evaluation targets. Post-revision, units cover distinct material facts: D1 (Q2 headline metrics), D2 (balance sheet movements), D3 (subsidiary contributions), D4 (strategic developments), D5 (capital position), D6 (macro context), D7 (H1 consolidated results), D8 (credit risk), D9 (asset management), D10 (plan adherence). No unit evaluates the same content as another.

key_information_units.information: Q2 2026 headline financial performance: net profit EUR 24.7 million (+25% QoQ, -20% YoY), net income EUR 79.0 million (+7% QoQ, +7% YoY), return on equity 13.1% (vs 10.7% QoQ, 17.4% YoY).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Summary section: Net profit, net income, ROE figures and comparisons with Q1 2026 and Q2 2025.

key_information_units.information: Loan portfolio grew to EUR 5,768 million (+3% QoQ, +15% YoY) while deposits decreased by EUR 245 million QoQ (ordinary client deposits +EUR 105 million, financial intermediaries -EUR 74 million, platform deposits -EUR 276 million).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Summary and Note 12: Loan portfolio growth, deposit breakdown by client type, and quarterly changes.

key_information_units.information: Subsidiary Q2 net profits: LHV Pank EUR 24.3 million, LHV Bank Limited EUR 1.4 million, AS LHV Varahaldus EUR 0.4 million, AS LHV Kindlustus EUR 0.8 million (LHV Paytech reported a net loss of EUR 0.3 million).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Overviews of AS LHV Pank, LHV Bank Limited, AS LHV Varahaldus, and AS LHV Kindlustus sections.

key_information_units.information: Strategic operational developments: migration of LHV Pank's core systems to Amazon Web Services cloud environment, receipt of MiCA crypto-asset service provider licence, and planned rebranding to LHV Bank AS to support international growth.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Overview of AS LHV Pank section: details on cloud migration, MiCA licence, and name change plans.

key_information_units.information: Capital adequacy ratio of 20.8% (vs 22.4% at end-2025) and liquidity coverage ratio of 171.5% (vs 185.0% at end-2025), with core Tier 1 ratio at 15.81% and Tier 1 ratio at 17.49%.
key_information_units.source_evidence: The Group's Liquidity, Capitalisation and Asset Quality section and Note 16.

key_information_units.information: Operating environment impacted by Middle East conflict de-escalation and energy price volatility, with OECD forecasting 2.8% global growth for 2026 contingent on Strait of Hormuz stability.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Operating Environment section: geopolitical tensions, energy prices, and OECD economic outlook.

key_information_units.information: First half 2026 consolidated results: net profit EUR 44.4 million (-26% YoY), net income EUR 152.7 million (approximately flat YoY), and loan impairment charges EUR 7.1 million (vs EUR 1.5 million in H1 2025).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Summary tables for 6M 2026: net profit, net income, and impairment charges compared to 6M 2025.

key_information_units.information: Loan and bond portfolio impairment charges increased to EUR 5.8 million in Q2 2026 (from EUR 1.3 million in Q1 2026 and EUR -4.2 million in Q2 2025), driven by model-based forward-looking provisions.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Summary and Note 20: impairment charges for Q2 2026 and comparisons with prior periods.

key_information_units.information: Managed funds increased to EUR 1,790 million (+4% QoQ, +15% YoY) with LHV Varahaldus reporting strong Q2 performance in index funds, while actively managed pension funds showed mixed results.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Overview of AS LHV Varahaldus section: fund volumes, active clients, and performance of pension funds.

key_information_units.information: Performance against financial plan: Q2 net income slightly below plan due to higher expenses, loan portfolio growth according to plan, but deposits remained below plan.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Summary section: Management Board commentary on plan variances.

id_normalization.note: Python normalized final key-information IDs to sequential K1..Kn without changing criterion content.
